unBU1PwCnvQ.description:
In this session we solve the linear convection equation with a physics-informed neural network in PyTorch.

0:00 Introduction
1:30 Define the network in PyTorch
6:10 Physics loss with autograd
12:40 Train on the convection equation
19:05 Compare with the exact solution

segs.utf8: welcome back, today we code a PINN for the linear convection equation
let's open VS Code and write the network class in PyTorch
class PINN(nn.Module) with three hidden layers and tanh
now the physics loss: torch.autograd.grad gives u_t and u_x
we train with Adam for 5000 epochs and print the loss every 500
and the prediction matches the exact solution of the convection equation
